test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Criteria to be selected as Junior Analyst

Eligibility Criteria (as on 15-07-2023):

Must have a B.Sc. in Statistics / Mathematics with minimum 65% marks.

Age between 23 and 30 years.

Must have completed a Data Analytics Certificate course.

Should have 2 years of analytical work experience.

Special Case:

If candidate has only 1 year experience, but has Master's degree in Data Science, refer to Project Manager.

Case:

Meera is 26 years old, B.Sc. in Statistics with 70% marks, has done a certificate course and holds a Master's in Data Science. She has only 1 year experience.

What should be done in Meera's case?
solution:
All the conditions are as follows:

 
 

 **Condition Number**
 **Detail**
 **Fulfillment**
 
 

 (a)
 Must have a B.Sc. in Statistics / Mathematics with minimum 65% marks.
 Yes – Meera has B.Sc. in Statistics with 70% marks
 
 

 (b)
 Age between 23 and 30 years.
 Yes – She is 26 years old
 
 

 (c)
 Must have completed a Data Analytics Certificate course.
 Yes – She has completed the certificate course
 
 

 (d)
 Should have 2 years of analytical work experience.
 No – She has only 1 year experience
 
 

 Special Case
 If candidate has only 1 year experience, but has Master's degree in Data Science → refer to Project Manager.
 Applies – She has 1 year experience and a Master’s in Data Science
 
 

 

Here, Meera fulfills all criteria except the experience requirement. However, as per the special case, since she has only 1 year of experience but also holds a Master’s in Data Science, her case should be referred to the Project Manager.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (1)"**.
